intro: The 2 bedroom is the workhorse of WashU off-campus housing: one friend, one lease, and a per-person price that beats living alone almost every time.

Everything below is live inventory on Proximity with walk times to campus already computed and reviews from students who lived in the building. Do the per-person math before you tour: the sticker price is for the whole unit, so your share is roughly half.
directAnswer: 2 bedroom apartments near WashU are concentrated in Skinker-DeBaliviere, University City, and around the Delmar Loop. For context, HUD's FY2026 fair market rent for a 2 bedroom is $1,140 in Skinker-DeBaliviere (63112) and $1,360 in University City (63130), whole unit, utilities included.

faqs.q: How much is a 2 bedroom apartment near WashU?
faqs.a: HUD's FY2026 fair market rent for a 2 bedroom is $1,140 in ZIP 63112 (Skinker-DeBaliviere), $1,360 in 63130 (University City), and $1,730 in 63105 (Clayton), whole unit with utilities included. Those are 40th percentile ZIP-wide benchmarks; buildings marketed to students near campus generally price above them. Each listing above shows its real current rent.

faqs.q: What does a 2 bedroom cost per person?
faqs.a: Take the unit rent and divide by two, then add utilities if they are not included. That split is why 2 bedrooms are the most popular student setup: your share usually lands well below what a 1 bedroom or studio costs on its own.

faqs.q: When should two of us sign a lease for next year?
faqs.a: Students consistently report that private landlords start signing for the next school year around November, and the good 2 bedrooms move first. WashU-affiliated companies like Quadrangle and Parallel typically open signing in spring. If you have your person locked in by late fall, you get the best selection.

faqs.q: Are rents near WashU going up?
faqs.a: Yes, modestly. Zillow's rent index for ZIP 63130 (University City) was up 5.0% year over year and 63112 (Skinker-DeBaliviere) up 6.5% as of June 2026, against about 4.0% for the St. Louis metro. Source: Zillow Research. Signing earlier in the cycle generally beats waiting.

benchmarkNote: Rent context on this page cites HUD FY2026 Small Area Fair Market Rents (huduser.gov), whole-unit figures with utilities included, and Zillow ZORI ZIP-level trend data as of June 2026. Source: HUD; Source: Zillow Research. Proximity does not publish averages computed from its own listings.
